create_back_legs: create back legs for a dog model by adding hip, knee, ankle, and toe joints with collision geometry
build_dog_upper_legs: build upper leg bodies with femur meshes, hip joints, and knee sites for left and right sides
build_dog_lower_legs: build lower leg bodies with tibia and fibula meshes, knee joints, and ankle sites for both sides
build_dog_feet: build foot bodies with tarsal bones, ankle joints, toe sites, and collision primitives for each side
build_dog_toes: build toe bodies with phalange meshes, toe joints, sole sensor sites, and nail geometry for each side
